messages:
deploy-bot: releasebot paused rollout v2.7.1 -> prod — preflight env-parity check failed (check_id=8342). Staging uses INFER_CACHE_PREFIX, prod uses INFERENCE_CACHE_PREFIX. Potential cache key mismatch; pods may read stale/empty cache and return 500s.

elaine: that's on me — I renamed the helm value last week during the chart refactor and only updated the staging overlay. missed prod override, sorry.

sam: @elaine which services are impacted? realtime-inference only or also batch/reranker?

elaine: realtime-inference + reranker. Canary had an overlay that set both keys, so it didn't break during testing. prod doesn't.

jordan: risk if we force forward: pods start with different env var names -> cache not found -> higher error rate for a few minutes. I vote pin/backfill instead of forcing new naming in prod.

nate: Pin to image v2.7.0 (pre-rename) for prod until we reconcile helm values. That buys time and keeps canary in place.

elaine: alternative quick fix: add an explicit helm override that sets INFER_CACHE_PREFIX and INFERENCE_CACHE_PREFIX to the same value for prod, roll prod, then follow up with a chart sync. Patch command I ran in staging as reference:

```bash
# temporary override applied as a kubectl env patch on the deployment (stopgap)
kubectl -n inference patch deployment realtime-inference --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-","value":{"name":"INFER_CACHE_PREFIX","valueFrom":{"configMapKeyRef":{"name":"inference-config","key":"cache_prefix"}}}}]'
```

sam: 👍 if we do the patch, we should run a short smoke test hitting hot paths (prompt->response) and check 5xx rate. @release-coordinator can we get a quick approval to unpause after patch?

release-coordinator: I'll approve unpause only after @elaine posts the patch command output and smoke test results. Also please attach the ticket to track permanent fix.

elaine: applied the patch to prod (logs below). Smoke test: 50 requests/30s, 0 5xx, p95 latency 220ms. Paste of kubectl rollout status:

```
deployment "realtime-inference" successfully rolled out
```

elaine: created INF-523 to standardize env var names across overlays and add preflight check for env-key parity.

release-coordinator: unpausing now. will monitor. thanks for the quick patch. :eyes:

deploy-bot: releasebot resumed rollout v2.7.1 -> prod after manual override by elaine. canary OK, prod progressing.

jordan: follow-up action items: 1) INF-523 on charts sync, 2) add parity check in preflight (fail release if key mismatch), 3) add postdeploy alert for spike in 5xx tied to cache keys.

nate: I'll own postdeploy alert rule.

sam: leaving a note to retro — small human error, fine stopgap, add automation to prevent this. :+1:

release-coordinator: closing thread for now; monitoring window open for 30m. will reopen if we see regressions.
